content.thinking:
A bug in the 'noisy' case: the link max should be 6 but got 4. This is from my new link-range shortcut:

```python
if zlb == zub or cur == zlb:
    mn = mx = cur
```

That's wrong! If `cur == zlb` (the witness attains the lower bound), then mn = cur ✓ but mx is NOT necessarily cur! I made an error when merging the branches. It should be:

```python
if zlb == zub:
    mn = mx = zlb
elif cur == zlb:
    mn = cur
    mx = prog.maximize(...)
elif cur == zub:
    mn = prog.minimize(...)
    mx = cur
else:
    mn = prog.minimize(...)
    mx = prog.maximize(...)
```

Let me fix that block.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PY'
p = 'infer.py'
src = open(p).read()
old = '''                            if zlb == zub or cur == zlb:
                                mn = mx = cur
                            elif cur == zub:
                                mn = prog.minimize(local.link[ei], zlb, cur)
                                mx = cur
                            else:'''
new = '''                            if zlb == zub:
                                mn = mx = zlb
                            elif cur == zlb:
                                mn = cur
                                mx = prog.maximize(local.link[ei], zub, cur)
                                if mx is None:
                                    return None
                            elif cur == zub:
                                mn = prog.minimize(local.link[ei], zlb, cur)
                                mx = cur
                                if mn is None:
                                    return None
                            else:'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open(p, 'w').write(src)
